description_nb: Canonical-first pipeline aligned to original v3.4 12-parent architecture (mode A).

steps.purpose: extract text and preserve page markers
map extracted segments to canonical child nodes using aliases/regex_any with IGNORECASE
build instances for parent categories that support instances
run scoring model and existing meta rules unchanged
aggregate child findings and instance findings to the 12 parent cards
render public output using canonical parent labels only

critical_rules: Always render exactly 12 parent cards in display_order.
Parent labels must come from canonical points only.
Children must never render as cards.
Instances must render only inside the relevant parent card.
Score on child; roll up to parent.
Lovlighet og sikkerhet must never require TG.
